name: Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception
description: A stunning baroque-style church with a striking white facade and a prominent bell tower, offering panoramic views of Panaji.

name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
description: A charming heritage neighborhood with colorful Portuguese-style houses, narrow lanes, and quaint cafes reflecting Goa's colonial past.

name: Mahalaxmi Temple
description: A revered Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Mahalaxmi, known for its serene atmosphere and intricate architecture.

name: Goa State Museum
description: A museum showcasing Goa's rich history, art, and culture through an extensive collection of artifacts and exhibits.

name: Dona Paula Viewpoint
description: A scenic viewpoint offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea and the confluence of the Mandovi and Zuari rivers.

name: Mandovi River Cruise
description: An enchanting evening boat cruise on the Mandovi River featuring live music, dance performances, and stunning sunset views.

name: Panaji Market
description: A bustling local market offering fresh produce, spices, handicrafts, and an authentic taste of Goan daily life.

name: Shri Shantadurga Temple
description: A beautifully maintained temple dedicated to Goddess Shantadurga, known for its peaceful ambiance and intricate carvings.

name: Kala Academy
description: A premier cultural center hosting art exhibitions, music concerts, and theater performances showcasing Goan talent.

name: Miramar Beach
description: A popular sandy beach near Panaji, perfect for a relaxing stroll, swimming, and enjoying local street food stalls.

name: Adil Shah's Palace
description: Ruins of a 16th-century palace built by the Adil Shahi dynasty, offering a glimpse into Goa's pre-Portuguese history.

name: Sahakari Spice Farm
description: An immersive tour through lush spice plantations with guided walks, traditional Goan lunch, and spice shopping.

name: Goa State Central Library
description: A historic library with an extensive collection of books and manuscripts, ideal for literature enthusiasts and researchers.

name: Panaji Promenade
description: A scenic walkway along the Mandovi River lined with gardens, sculptures, and cafes, perfect for an evening stroll.

name: St. Sebastian Chapel
description: A quaint chapel known for its beautiful stained glass windows and peaceful surroundings in the heart of Panaji.

name: Goa Science Centre
description: An interactive science museum featuring exhibits on space, technology, and natural sciences, great for families and kids.

name: Panaji Boat Jetty
description: A lively jetty where visitors can catch ferries and boats to explore nearby islands and scenic river routes.

name: Mandovi Bridge
description: An iconic bridge over the Mandovi River offering spectacular views of Panaji and the surrounding water bodies.

name: Viceroy's Arch
description: A historic gateway built during the Portuguese era, symbolizing the colonial heritage of Panaji city.

name: Goa State Art Gallery
description: An art gallery exhibiting contemporary and traditional Goan art, sculptures, and crafts by local artists.
